node_feature_recipe_decision: Fresh UniMol cls_repr does not reproduce the L1000 node-feature file; the L1000 node features are not reproducible by the current unimol_tools pipeline (a different UniMol model version produced them). Per the feature spec the FDA-extension node features use the mol-token recipe regardless. To avoid feature drift and stay closest to the L1000 recipe, the FDA mol-token is read from the frozen workflow UniMol array (cls_repr at rows 0-1, feature cols 2:514) rather than freshly generated — that array is the repo's single source of UniMol features and its mol-token is cos≈0.97 with the L1000 node features (fresh generation is cos≈0.16).
